editorial:
Imagine you are a successful TV news anchor who just wants some peace and quiet after a messy divorce. You head to your lonely country house to relax, but things go south fast when a creepy killer starts following you. This movie sets up a scary mood right away, mixing that lonely country vibe with the fear of being watched. You get to feel the tension as the main character realizes she is not alone and that a psycho who targets strippers has decided she is his next big prize.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you on edge without getting too complicated. The acting is solid, and the pacing moves quickly so you never get bored. While some of the special effects feel a bit dated, the suspense makes up for it. If you love old-school thrillers with a high body count, you will dig this one. You can find it by renting on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want the best picture quality possible for your home theater setup.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, you find out the killer had a deep, twisted obsession with the anchorwoman's public image. After a tense game of cat and mouse around the house, she manages to fight back using her surroundings to trap him. She eventually kills the stalker in a desperate struggle for survival. The movie ends with her safe, but clearly shaken, as she leaves the remote house behind for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic stalker movies and suspenseful mysteries.
